assertion: The claimant stopped briefly, looked at the vehicles, and then left because they were concerned about being stranded late at night
The claimant did not see anyone inside the parked vehicle
The claimant did not believe anyone was injured
The claimant recalls that it had been raining earlier and that the pavement was wet.
The claimant states they were driving around 25 to 30 mph before beginning the turn.
According to the claimant, the turn was normal until the vehicle suddenly slid.
The claimant states they tried to correct the vehicle but the front of the Mercedes contacted a parked SUV.
The claimant states they did not see anyone inside the parked SUV and did not believe anyone was injured.
The claimant states they stopped after the collision, looked at the vehicles, and then left because they were concerned about being stranded late at night.
The claimant states they intended to report the incident.
The claimant does not recall the exact distance traveled, whether traction control activated, whether another vehicle was nearby, whether there was a witness, or the exact impact location.
